entries.title: Philippians 1:1
segments: To all Christ's People at Philippi, with the Presiding Officers and Assistants, from Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 1:2
segments: May God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ bless you, and give you peace.

entries.title: Philippians 1:3
segments: Every recollection that I have of you is a cause of thankfulness to God,

entries.title: Philippians 1:4
segments: Always, in every prayer that I offer for you all--my prayers are full of joy--

entries.title: Philippians 1:5
segments: Because of the share that you have had in spreading the Good News, from the first day that you received it until now.

entries.title: Philippians 1:6
segments: For of this I am confident, that he who began a good work in you will complete it in readiness for the Day of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 1:7
segments: And, indeed, I am justified in feeling thus about you all; because you have a warm place in my heart--you who all, both in my imprisonment and in the work of defending and establishing the Good News, shared my privilege with me.

entries.title: Philippians 1:8
segments: God will bear me witness how I yearn over you all with the tenderness of Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 1:9
segments: And what I pray for is this--that your love may grow yet stronger and stronger, with increasing knowledge and all discernment,

entries.title: Philippians 1:10
segments: Until you are able to appreciate all moral distinctions. And I pray, too, that you may be kept pure and blameless against the Day of Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 1:11
segments: Bearing a rich harvest of that righteousness which comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

entries.title: Philippians 1:12
segments: Brothers, I want you to realize that what has happened to me has actually served to forward the Good News.

entries.title: Philippians 1:13
segments: It has even become evident, not only to all the Imperial Guard, but to every one else, that it is for Christ's sake that I am in chains.

entries.title: Philippians 1:14
segments: And besides this, most of our Brothers have gained confidence in the Lord through my chains, and now venture with far greater freedom to speak of God's Message fearlessly.

entries.title: Philippians 1:15
segments: It is true that some do proclaim the Christ out of Jealousy and opposition; but there are others who proclaim him from good- will.

entries.title: Philippians 1:16
segments: The latter do it from love for me, knowing that I have been appointed to plead the cause of the Good News.

entries.title: Philippians 1:17
segments: The former spread the news of the Christ in a factious spirit, and not sincerely, thinking to add to the pain of my chains.

entries.title: Philippians 1:18
segments: But what of that? Only that in some way or other, either with assumed or with real earnestness, Christ is being made known; and at that I rejoice.

entries.title: Philippians 1:19
segments: Yes, and I will rejoice, for I know that, through your prayers and through a rich supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, 'all this will make for my Salvation.'

entries.title: Philippians 1:20
segments: And this will fulfil my earnest expectation and hope that I shall have no cause for shame, but that, with unfailing courage, now as hitherto, Christ will be honored in my body, whether by my life or by my death,

entries.title: Philippians 1:21
segments: For to me life is Christ, and death is gain.

entries.title: Philippians 1:22
segments: But what if the life here in the body--if this brings me fruit from my labors? Then which to choose I cannot tell! I am sorely perplexed either way!

entries.title: Philippians 1:23
segments: My own desire is to depart and be with Christ, for this would be far better.

entries.title: Philippians 1:24
segments: But, for your sakes, it may be more needful that I should still remain here in the body.

entries.title: Philippians 1:25
segments: Yes, I am confident that this is so, and therefore I am sure that I shall stay, and stay near you all, to promote your progress and joy in the Faith;

entries.title: Philippians 1:26
segments: So that, when you once more have me among you, you, in your union with Christ Jesus, may find in me fresh cause for exultation.

entries.title: Philippians 1:27
segments: Under all circumstances let your lives be worthy of the Good News of the Christ: so that, whether I come and see you, or whether I hear of your affairs at a distance, I may know that you are standing firm, animated by one spirit, and joining with one heart in a common struggle for the Faith taught by the Good News,

entries.title: Philippians 1:28
segments: Without ever shrinking from your opponents. To them this will be a sign of their Destruction and of your Salvation--a sign from God.

entries.title: Philippians 1:29
segments: For, on behalf of Christ, you have had the privilege granted you, not only of trusting in him, but also of suffering on his behalf.

entries.title: Philippians 1:30
segments: You will be engaged in the same hard struggle as that which you once saw me waging, and which you hear that I am waging still.
